purpose: Reproduce the published Qwen2.5-VL-3B example and assess the untuned canonical-start intervention on the exploratory Mantis benchmark
canonical_start: Copy first vision-start attention-normalized representation into later vision-start positions at every layer; preserve rotary positions; leave vision-end and ordinary tokens intact.
interpretation: This is exploratory mechanism evaluation, not proof of novelty or held-out confirmation. Canonicalization is not advanced if correctness collapses. Full multi-benchmark confirmation still required.
